{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the actual channels
actual_channels = sales['channel'].unique()
print("Actual channels present:", actual_channels)

# Filter out refunded orders (they are not revenue)
completed_mask = sales['status'] == 'completed'

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == '999999.99'

# Combine filters: only completed, non-QA orders
valid_mask = completed_mask & ~qa_mask

# Extract valid orders
valid_sales = sales[valid_mask]

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
valid_sales['revenue_float'] = valid_sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = valid_sales.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_float'].sum()

# Sort by revenue descending
channel_revenue_sorted = channel_revenue.sort_values(by='revenue_float', ascending=False)

# Display results
channel_revenue_sorted"}
